# Joseph Salazar Website

## Project Overview
Personal portfolio website for Joseph Salazar — a musician, composer, and artist. The site showcases music releases, scoring work, events, and social links.

## Structure
- `index.html` — Landing page with coming soon message, social links, embedded YouTube videos, and Mailchimp signup
- `js-portfolio.html` — Full portfolio with sections: About, Scoring, Recent Releases, Events, Press, Other Work, Social Media, Contact
- `assets/` — Static assets
  - `images/` — All images (event flyers, album art, project thumbnails)
  - `css/` — Stylesheets
  - `js/` — JavaScript files

## Key Details
- Uses Font Awesome 6.5.1 for social icons
- Google Fonts: Antonio (headings) and Montserrat (body)
- Dark theme with off-white text (#f0f0e6, #dcdcd0)
- Responsive design with mobile breakpoints at 600px
- Open Graph and Twitter card meta tags on both pages using `assets/images/js-website-home-slider-minimoog.jpg`

## Image References
All images are served from `assets/images/` — no external image hosts (except Bandcamp CDN for album art and YouTube embeds).

## Social Links
YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Spotify, Bandcamp, Email
